nodes.description: Public mapping(address=>uint) balanceOf holding token balances of SafeKloki; written in transferFrom and batchSend.
Public nested mapping allowance[owner][spender] used for approval accounting in approve and transferFrom.
Private mapping counting sales per address; incremented in transferFrom and read in condition.
Private mapping(address=>bool) whitelist consulted by ensure to bypass sale conditions.
Private minimum sale amount per transfer; set by init and read by condition.
Private maximum sale amount per transfer; set by init and read by condition.
Private maximum number of sales per address; set by init and read by condition.
Address exempted from sale conditions; set by setTradeAddress and read by ensure.
Privileged owner address, assigned from msg.sender in constructor and gate for admin functions.
Total token supply, minted to the deployer in the constructor.
Public payable transfer that delegates to transferFrom with msg.sender as the source.
Internal view guard building the UNI pair address and checking owner/whitelist exemptions before calling condition.
Public payable transfer entry point that updates allowance, balances and _onSaleNum; mutates state without a reentrancy guard.
Public payable approval writing allowance[msg.sender][spender].
Internal view sale-condition checker reading _saleNum, _minSale, _maxSale and _onSaleNum.
Owner-only function performing delegatecall to an arbitrary address and calldata.
Owner-only initializer computing _minSale/_maxSale with multiplication by 10**decimals and setting _saleNum.
Owner-only bulk transfer looping over an address array and computing total = _value * _tos.length.
Owner-only setter for the tradeAddress exemption.
Internal pure Uniswap-style pair address derivation from factory and two tokens.
Payable constructor assigning metadata, totalSupply, owner=msg.sender and unlimited UNI allowance.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, allowances, balance debits and admin gating.
Low-level delegatecall to an attacker-supplied address and payload executed in SafeKloki storage context.
Unchecked multiplication uint total = _value * _tos.length with no SafeMath, allowing wrap-around.
Unchecked multiplication token*(10**uint256(decimals)) and maxToken*(10**uint256(decimals)) without SafeMath.
Low-level address(token).call(data) followed by decoding of optional return data.
Private helper verifying the target is a contract and performing the low-level ERC20 call.
Destination address of transfer, forwarded to transferFrom.
Amount of transfer, forwarded to transferFrom.
Debited address, checked against msg.sender allowance and ensure.
Credited address in transferFrom.
Transferred amount, compared against allowance and balance.
Spender granted allowance by msg.sender.
Allowance amount written to allowance mapping.
Address whose _onSaleNum is checked against _saleNum.
Transfer amount checked against _minSale and _maxSale.
Target address of the delegatecall.
Raw calldata forwarded to the delegatecall target.
Minimum sale value in whole tokens, scaled by 10**decimals.
Maximum sale value in whole tokens, scaled by 10**decimals.
Array of recipients; its length multiplies _value to form the debited total.
Per-recipient amount, multiplied by the recipient count.
New trade exemption address.
Whole-token supply scaled into totalSupply.
Local total = _value * _tos.length computed without overflow protection.
Loop counter over the recipient array.
Derived pair address for WETH/SafeKloki used in the whitelist comparison.
Computed deterministic pair address returned by pairFor.

edges.reason: msg.sender determines the allowance check and is the implicit actor of transferFrom state updates.
approve writes allowance keyed by the caller-controlled msg.sender.
owner is assigned from msg.sender in the constructor, making ownership caller-dependent.
delegate gates the arbitrary delegatecall behind require(msg.sender == owner).
init is only reachable when msg.sender equals owner.
batchSend is only reachable when msg.sender equals owner.
setTradeAddress is only reachable when msg.sender equals owner.
transfer forwards execution to transferFrom with msg.sender as source.
transferFrom invokes ensure as a transfer precondition.
ensure calls condition when the sender is not exempt.
ensure derives the UNI pair address via pairFor.
delegate performs a delegatecall to a caller-supplied address and payload.
init arguments feed the unchecked multiplications by 10**decimals.
batchSend computes _value * _tos.length without SafeMath, allowing wraparound.
pairFor assigns the keccak-derived address to the returned local pair.
callOptionalReturn executes the low-level call to the token address.
transferFrom debits balanceOf[_from] and credits balanceOf[_to] before emitting Transfer.
transferFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender] when the caller is not the source.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] on every transfer.
approve stores the amount into allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from] against _saleNum.
condition compares the transfer value with _minSale.
condition compares the transfer value with _maxSale.
condition returns early when _saleNum is zero.
ensure consults canSale[_from] to exempt whitelisted addresses.
ensure compares _from against tradeAddress.
ensure compares _from and _to against owner.
ensure stores the derived pair address in the local _UNI.
init writes the scaled token value into _minSale.
init writes the scaled maxToken value into _maxSale.
init writes saleNum into _saleNum.
batchSend debits balanceOf[msg.sender] and credits each recipient.
setTradeAddress stores addr into tradeAddress.
constructor sets owner to msg.sender.
constructor assigns the scaled supply to totalSupply.
constructor credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with totalSupply.
constructor grants uint(-1) allowance to the UNI router.
transfer destination parameter is forwarded to transferFrom.
transfer amount parameter is forwarded to transferFrom.
_from selects the allowance key, balance debit and ensure check.
_to receives the credited balance.
_value bounds the allowance and balance debits.
_spender keys the allowance mapping written by approve.
_value is the allowance amount stored by approve.
_from is used to look up _onSaleNum inside condition.
_value is bounded by _minSale and _maxSale inside condition.
parameter a is the delegatecall target.
parameter b is the raw calldata of the delegatecall.
token is scaled by 10**decimals to set _minSale.
maxToken is scaled by 10**decimals to set _maxSale.
_tos length multiplies _value and drives the transfer loop.
_value is multiplied by the recipient count and credited per recipient.
addr is written into tradeAddress.
_supply is scaled and assigned to totalSupply.
the local total is the product whose overflow is unbounded.
loop counter i drives the batchSend iteration.
unbounded _tos length directly scales the overflowing total computation.
unvalidated _value feeds the unchecked multiplication.
token feeds token*(10**uint256(decimals)) with no overflow check.
maxToken feeds maxToken*(10**uint256(decimals)) with no overflow check.

normalization_plan.reason: transfer._to is a parameter consumed only by the transfer function; fold it into the function node.
transfer._value is a parameter consumed only by the transfer function; fold it into the function node.
transferFrom._from is a parameter consumed only by transferFrom; fold it into the function node.
transferFrom._to is a parameter consumed only by transferFrom; fold it into the function node.
transferFrom._value is a parameter consumed only by transferFrom; fold it into the function node.
approve._spender is a parameter consumed only by approve; fold it into the function node.
approve._value is a parameter consumed only by approve; fold it into the function node.
condition._from is a parameter consumed only by condition; fold it into the function node.
condition._value is a parameter consumed only by condition; fold it into the function node.
delegate.a is a parameter consumed only by delegate; fold it into the function node that performs the delegatecall.
delegate.b is a parameter consumed only by delegate; fold it into the function node that performs the delegatecall.
init.token is a parameter consumed only by init; fold it into the function node.
init.maxToken is a parameter consumed only by init; fold it into the function node.
batchSend._tos is a parameter consumed only by batchSend and by its unsafe multiplication.
batchSend._value is a parameter consumed only by batchSend and by its unsafe multiplication.
setTradeAddress.addr is a parameter consumed only by setTradeAddress; fold it into the function node.
constructor._supply is a parameter consumed only by the constructor; fold it into the function node.
batchSend.total is the local holding the overflowing product, so it merges into the arithmetic unsafe operation.
batchSend.i is a loop-local counter with no independent security role; fold it into batchSend.
ensure._UNI is a temporary holding the derived pair address used only inside ensure; fold it into ensure.
pairFor.pair is the returned local of pairFor and has no independent role; fold it into pairFor.
